```{r}

```
different types of variables

```{r}
character_variable <- "hello"
print(character_variable)
print(class(character_variable))
numerical_variable <- 5
print(numerical_variable)
print(class(numerical_variable))
logical_variable <- FALSE
print(logical_variable)
print(class(logical_variable))
```

```{r}
treated_2 <- FALSE

num_cells_before_2 <- 8123
num_cells_after_1 <- 1432

```

data frame
```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  fruit = c("apple", "pear", "banana"),
  length = c(22, 30, 55),
  weight = c(150, 165, 170)
)


print(my_data_frame)

fruits <- c("apple", "pear", "banana")
lengths <- c(22, 30, 55)
weights <- c(150, 165, 170)

my_data_frame <- tibble(
  fruit = fruits,
  length = lengths,
  weight = weights
)


print(my_data_frame)
```
formatting data frame
```{r}
print(my_data_frame)

fruits <- c("apple", "pear", "banana")
lengths <- c(22, 30, 55)
weights <- c(150, 165, 170)

gt(my_data_frame)
```
radiation data frame
```{r}
my_radiation_data_frame <- tibble(
  cell_ID = cell_ID,
  treated = treated,
  num_cells_before = num_cells_before,
  num_cells_after = num_cells_after
)
gt(my_radiation_data_frame)
```
